title: plural_noun crashes with IndexError on title-cased 'X Of A Y' compounds
property: plural_noun never raises on a valid non-empty word/phrase, including when the phrase is capitalised
expected: 'Sons Of Guns' (lowercase 'son of a gun' gives 'sons of guns')
actual: IndexError: list index out of range in engine.postprocess (inflect/__init__.py:2376)
evidence: plural_noun accepts any Word; lowercase 'son of a gun' -> 'sons of guns' is tested in tests/test_pwd.py. The dual-compound branch of _plnoun drops the 'a', so the result has fewer words than the input, and postprocess's per-word capitalisation loop indexes result[index] for each original word, which overruns when the original word 'A' is capitalised.
